title: Incwadi ye-permaculture
subtitle: Isikhokelo esiphathekayo soyilo lwe-permaculture, ukutyala ukutya nokuphila ngokuzinzileyo sabalimi nemizi yaseMzantsi weAfrika.
draftNotice: Olu guqulelo lwenziwe ngomatshini kwaye alukahlolwa ngumntu othetha isiXhosa kakuhle. Ukuba kukho into engacacanga, funda isahluko sesiNgesi.
credit: Yahlanganiswa nguRory Clark, Imbewu Yoshintso NPC. Yahlolwa yaza yaqhubekekiswa kuMzantsi Afrika, 2026. Iinxalenye ezithile zithathwe kwincwadi ye-African Conservation Trust ethi Introduction to Permaculture and Homestead Gardening (2014).
